title: Show HN: Bigwords.page – Turn any screen into a sign. The URL is the app
summary: Bigwords.page is a minimalist web app that transforms any browser screen into a customizable sign or display board. Users simply visit the URL and type their text, which instantly appears in large format. The entire app lives in the URL, requiring no sign-up, download, or installation.
problem_solved: Provides an instant, frictionless way to display large text on any screen for presentations, streaming, or communication without specialized software.
why_valuable: Eliminates friction entirely by making the URL itself the entire application—anyone can use it in under 3 seconds without any setup or learning curve.
